rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Miniature.
Registration name: WEKwibypur
Exhibition name: Diamond Eyes
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, before 2010).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2013 as 'Diamond Eyes'.
rows.Bloom: Dark purple, white center, lighter reverse. Strong fragrance. 23 to 32 petals. Average diameter 2". Medium, very double, cluster-flowered, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Short, bushy, compact. Small, glossy, dark green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 26" to 35" (65 to 90cm). Width: 31" to 41" (80 to 105cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to disease.
